# NetworkTopologyEffects

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The influence of graph structure (e.g., small-world, scale-free, modular) on the emergent collective dynamics of spiking neural networks. Topology directly shapes information propagation and computational capacity, bridging TCC's focus on structure with iNEST's neural dynamics.
